Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.tuning.model

Class TuningExperiment

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.tuning.model.TuningExperiment
public class TuningExperiment extends Object
Represents a collection of timing parameters and their execution results.

TuningExperiment encapsulates both input parameters for action timing and the results obtained when executing actions with those parameters. This dual nature makes it ideal for parameter tuning, where different parameter combinations are tested and their outcomes recorded for optimization.

Key components:

  • Input parameters: Timing values that control action execution
  • Result metrics: Success status and timing measurements

Usage scenarios:

  1. Parameter tuning: Generate random parameters within thresholds, test them, and record results
  2. Configuration capture: Extract current parameters from ActionConfig for analysis
  3. Performance analysis: Compare different parameter sets based on success rates and timing

Design rationale:

Combining parameters with results in a single class facilitates machine learning and optimization algorithms that need to correlate inputs with outcomes. The random initialization constructor supports exploration-based tuning strategies.

  • Constructor Details

    • TuningExperiment

      public TuningExperiment()
      Creates a TuningExperiment with randomly generated parameters.

      Initializes all timing parameters with random values between 0 and their respective thresholds defined in TuningConstraints. This constructor is primarily used for parameter space exploration during automated tuning.

      The random distribution is uniform, giving equal probability to all values within the valid range. This ensures comprehensive exploration of the parameter space during optimization.

      Result fields (success, timeToAppear, timeToVanish) are left uninitialized and should be populated after action execution.

    • TuningExperiment

      public TuningExperiment(ActionConfig actionConfig)
      Creates a TuningExperiment from existing ActionConfig.

      Extracts timing parameters from the provided ActionConfig to create a collection that represents the current configuration. This constructor is useful for:

      • Capturing baseline parameters before tuning
      • Analyzing the performance of current settings
      • Creating variations of existing configurations

      Result fields are left uninitialized and should be populated based on actual execution outcomes.

      Parameters:
      actionConfig - The ActionConfig containing timing parameters to extract
